name: observability-design
description: Design comprehensive observability systems that provide visibility into system behavior through logs, metrics, and traces to enable effective monitoring, debugging, and optimization.
inputs: User journeys (critical paths through the system)
Failure modes (known and potential failure scenarios)
outputs: Observability strategy document (logging, metrics, tracing, alerting)
Instrumentation plan (what and how to instrument)
Dashboard designs (service health, business metrics, SLO dashboards)
Alert definitions (critical, warning alerts with routing)
